The remaining chapters are still source text and are queued. This page tracks coverage, the Indian sources used, and the helplines to save.

currency.title: Source amounts, with an Indian reference
currency.body: Some source-edition tips quote prices in the source currency. This edition keeps each original amount and adds an approximate INR reference, clearly marked with ≈. It is not a purchasing-power comparison: housing, healthcare, transport, food and wages differ sharply. Use the author's cost bands — Free, Small cost, Real money — for decisions, and treat the INR badge as rough orientation only.
currency.note: The original source amount is always retained. The INR reference is indicative, dated, and not financial advice.

helplines.label: Medical emergency
helplines.note: 112 is the all-in-one emergency number. 108 is the ambulance service in most states.

helplines.label: Police
helplines.note: 112 reaches police, fire and ambulance; 100 is the police helpline.

helplines.label: Fire
helplines.note: 101 is the fire helpline in most states.

helplines.label: Consular help abroad
helplines.note: Use the MADAD portal and the nearest Indian embassy or consulate. Save both before travelling.

helplines.label: Mental-health support
helplines.note: Tele-MANAS is free, multilingual and 24/7. For immediate danger, call 112.

helplines.label: Free legal aid
helplines.note: NALSA and state legal services authorities decide eligibility; women, children, SC/ST members and many low-income applicants qualify.

helplines.label: Consumer complaint
helplines.note: The National Consumer Helpline; you can also file on the consumeraffairs.nic.in portal.

helplines.label: Cyber fraud
helplines.note: Call 1930 quickly so the bank can try to stop the transfer; also file at cybercrime.gov.in.

helplines.label: Social-security help
helplines.note: There is no single equivalent. Use the EPFO and ESIC helplines or your employer's HR portal.

helplines.label: Government grievance
helplines.note: Most states run a 1900-series or 4-digit CM helpline; CPGRAMS covers central government departments.
